e.title: insurance-bunching
e.summary: Bunching 估计量（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：费率阈值博弈检测、暴露加权密度扭曲
e.summary_en: Bunching estimators (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): insurance threshold gaming detection, exposure-weighted density distortions
e.summary_hk: Bunching 估計量（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：費率閾值博弈檢測、暴露加權密度扭曲
e.body: insurance-bunching（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 bunching 估计量检测费率阈值博弈：暴露加权的密度扭曲分析——客户是否在费率阈值处策略性聚集（threshold gaming）。对 RIAA：阈值博弈是费率设计的实务问题（客户绕阈值调整行为）——[[insurance-rdd]]（断点回归）检测阈值效应、bunching 检测「密度堆积」；行为反应建模（客户对费率的策略性反应）；与 [[insurance-fairness]]（阈值公平）配套；适合定价行为经济学方向。
e.body_en: insurance-bunching (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) uses bunching estimators to detect rate-threshold gaming: exposure-weighted density distortion analysis — whether customers strategically cluster at rate thresholds. For RIAA: threshold gaming is a practical rate-design problem (customers adjust behaviour around thresholds) — [[insurance-rdd]] (regression discontinuity) detects threshold effects, bunching detects 'density heaps'; behavioural response modelling (strategic customer reactions to rates); pairs with [[insurance-fairness]] (threshold fairness); suits behavioural economics of pricing.
e.body_hk: insurance-bunching（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 bunching 估計量檢測費率閾值博弈：暴露加權的密度扭曲分析——客戶是否在費率閾值處策略性聚集（threshold gaming）。對 RIAA：閾值博弈是費率設計的實務問題（客戶繞閾值調整行為）——[[insurance-rdd]]（斷點迴歸）檢測閾值效應、bunching 檢測「密度堆積」；行為反應建模（客戶對費率的策略性反應）；與 [[insurance-fairness]]（閾值公平）配套；適合定價行為經濟學方向。
